newsitem.title: UK: Rexam shares gain on restructuring plans.
newsitem.headline: Rexam shares gain on restructuring plans.

text.p: Shares in Rexam Plc opened higher on Wednesday, after the paper and packaging group said it would restructure into seven sectors and sell non-core businesses with sales of 303 million stg.
The stock was up 10p at 346-1/2p by 0829 GMT.
"The market has taken it (the restructure plan) reasonably positively," said one analyst.
Said another: "I suspect it will call the bottom in the stock," but added that there were some worries about the lack of timescale given for the planned disposals.
"Until they announce some deals the shares may not run much further. It is just a bit of relief".
Rexam shares fell steadily to a year's closing low of 324-1/2p on Dec 6, after peaking at 406-1/2p on the close of September 10.
Rexam said the businesses in line for sale had operating assets of 161 million stg and made an annual operating loss of two million stg.
By 0919 GMT, the shares had retreated from their early gain to be up just 3-1/2p at 340p.
